facts.business: Shri Bajrang Alliance Limited operates through two segments: Steel (structural steel products for infrastructure, construction, engineering and industrial sectors) and Agro (frozen foods under the GOELD brand including frozen snacks, vegetables, Indian breads and value-added convenience foods for retail, institutional, modern trade, food service and export markets).

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Corporate Guarantee of Rs. 36,984 Lakhs to associate company, which is higher than company's net worth; disclosed as contingent liability with remote ultimate outcome but liquidity risk.

key_risks: Volatility in prices of iron ore, coking coal, ferro alloys, fuel and power impacting manufacturing costs and operating margins
Global geopolitical developments and supply chain disruptions influencing raw material availability and logistics costs
Pricing pressure from imported steel products during periods of excess global production capacity
Changes in international trade policies, anti-dumping measures and import duties influencing market dynamics
Corporate Guarantee of Rs. 36,984 Lakhs to associate company exceeding net worth, posing liquidity risk
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transactions with Shri Bajrang Power and Ispat Limited (Promoter Group Company) for aggregate value not exceeding Rs. 500 Crores for period from April 01, 2026 for 1 year on arm's length basis. Also approval sought for material related party transactions with Shri Bajrang Chemical Distillery LLP.
